shadows.name: tooltip-lift

motion.name: ease-reveal

components.name: Pill (light ground)
components.description: Chrome control: the back pill and sound toggle on light sections.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; font: 400 13px/1 Satoshi, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #102e30; background: color-mix(in srgb, #fffdf9 72%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, #102e30 22%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); transition: color 0.3s, background-color 0.3s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #102e30; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Pill (dark ground)
components.description: The same pill over the slate panels and photos.
components.css: .ds-pill-dark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; font: 400 13px/1 Satoshi, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #fffdf9; background: color-mix(in srgb, #102e30 72%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, #fffdf9 30%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); cursor: pointer; } .ds-pill-dark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fffdf9; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline button (dark)
components.description: In-page action on the specification panel.
components.css: .ds-outline { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: #fffdf9; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #fffdf9; font: 400 12px Satoshi, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fffdf9; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Jump link
components.description: Text link whose underline draws in from the left on hover and focus.
components.css: .ds-jump { position: relative; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; font: 400 12px/1 Satoshi, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #102e30; cursor: pointer; } .ds-jump::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -2px; width: 100%; height: 1px; background: currentColor; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.39, 0.575, 0.565, 1); } .ds-jump:hover::after, .ds-jump:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-jump:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #102e30; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Hairline field
components.description: Form field: a label above, a single bottom hairline, no box.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field span { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; font: 400 12px Satoshi, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: color-mix(in srgb, #102e30 75%, transparent); } .ds-field input { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 8px 2px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #102e30 30%, transparent); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; font: 400 15px Satoshi, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #102e30; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #102e30; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Price card
components.description: Beige, square card holding the price and the price strip.

components.css: .ds-card { background: #dbd7cb; padding: 20px; color: #102e30; } .ds-price { margin: 0; font: 400 56px/1 Satoshi, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-line { margin: 8px 0 0; font: 400 12px Satoshi, system-ui, sans-serif; color: color-mix(in srgb, #102e30 75%, transparent); }

components.name: Spec bar
components.description: The slate bar across the bottom of the hero: facts left, price right.
components.css: .ds-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; height: 68px; padding: 0 24px; background: #2c3638; color: #fffdf9; font-family: Satoshi, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-bar dl { display: flex; gap: 20px; margin: 0; } .ds-bar dl div { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: baseline; } .ds-bar dt, .ds-bar span { font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: color-mix(in srgb, #fffdf9 70%, transparent); } .ds-bar dd { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; } .ds-bar p { margin: 0; } .ds-bar b { font-weight: 400; font-size: 26px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
Arcade reads like a German sales brochure that turns its own pages. Each car's listing is one long horizontal spread: a cover with the name set huge behind the car, photo spreads, a magazine 'About' page, a dark specification sheet, a price page and a closing call to action. The grid is strict (five columns, 24 px margins and gutters, everything sized in one unit drawn at 1440 × 960), the ink is a deep teal rather than black, and the paper is a barely warm off-white. Nothing is decorated; hierarchy comes from scale, case and the layer the type sits on.

The car is the photograph. The one persistent 3D model moves through four camera poses as the page scrolls, and the page's dark panels pass over it and reveal it again. Type and fields sit behind the car; photos, panels and controls sit in front. Seller photos are unretouched and the cars carry all of the colour.

Motion is unhurried and masked: text rises from under a line, photos open with a clip, everything long and power3.out. Scroll-tied effects reverse with the scroll; triggered reveals play once.
keyCharacteristics: Deep teal ink on warm paper, slate panels, one beige card; no saturated UI colour.
Huge uppercase Satoshi display with tight tracking, condensed Staatliches for small heads.
A five-column grid at a single scale unit, with 24 px margins at every size.
Three layers: type behind the car, the car, photos and panels in front.
Square corners on everything that holds content; full pills only for controls.

rules.name: The Car Carries the Colour Rule
rules.body: The UI stays in ink, paper, slate, beige and field. Saturation belongs to the cars, their photos and the small full-colour maker emblems.

rules.name: The Translucent Ink Floor
rules.body: Secondary text is ink mixed with transparency, never below 75% on beige or paper (5.25:1 on the card) and 70% for captions on paper; the dark pill is ink at 72% so paper text holds 5.8:1 even over a white photo.

rules.name: The Floor Rule
rules.body: Every --u-scaled size carries a pixel floor, so the brochure scales down to 1024 × 640 without text falling below legibility.

rules.name: The Three Layers Rule
rules.body: Anything the car may pass over goes in the behind layer; anything that may cover the car goes in front. Every fact in 3D also exists as DOM text.

dos: Do keep every size on the --u scale with a pixel floor, and every margin at 24 px.
Do put type the car may cross in the behind layer and anything that may cover it in front.
Do reveal text from under a line mask and photos with clip-path: inset(); travel at most one line or ~15% of a photo.
Do say a verdict or a state in words; colour is never the only cue.
Do keep secondary text at 75% ink or more on beige and paper.
donts: Don't add UI colour: no accent fills, no coloured buttons; the cars carry the colour.
Don't round content corners (photos, panels, cards, fields); pills are for controls only.
Don't use shadows for depth; use the layers and the studio.
Don't animate layout properties; DOM motion is transform, opacity, filter: blur() (≤ 8 px) and, for image reveals only, clip-path: inset().
Don't cover the finale: the scroll-triggered enquiry opens without a scrim; only the button's open is modal.
Don't use Gran Turismo assets, logos or music; GT4 is a reference for feel only.
